preconditions.description: Number of strings is between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string has a length between 1 and 10.
Number of questions is between 1 and 500000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= R <= n for L, R, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R are within the range [1, n] and L <= R.
Each query string has a length between 1 and 10.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= (R - L + 1) for count in output)
postconditions.description: Each count is between 0 and the number of strings in the queried range.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(str in strings[L-1:R] for str in [query_str]) for count, (L, R, query_str) in zip(output, queries))
postconditions.description: Each count correctly represents the number of strings in the range [L, R] that contain the query string.
